description: Copia org-wide Renovate base policy (SC-835). Extend with local>copia-automation/.github

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes get their own unlimited budget on top of prConcurrentLimit (0 = no limit)

packageRules.description: Rollbacks and replacements should be deliberate human calls, not bot PRs
Pinning npm ranges is noise in application repos; digest pinning still applies to Actions and Docker
Batch all non-major updates per manager so the 3-PR budget covers every ecosystem; majors stay individual
